plan.notes: Source: Texas Southern University 2026-2027 Catalog (https://catalog.tsu.edu/undergraduate/schools-colleges/public-affairs/political-science/political-science-ba/), 'Summary' degree sequence. Retrieved 2026-10-07. CATALOG DISCREPANCY (documented, not resolved): the catalog page text declares 145 total hours, but the degree-sequence tables print per-table totals summing to 265. Seeded at 265 per the tables; every term total below reconciles with the printed term totals. The catalog repeats the following course(s) across terms, transcribed as published: ECON 2301, ECON 2302, ENGL 1301, ENGL 1302, FS 102, HIST 1301, HIST 1302, POLS 2305, POLS 2306, POLS 250, POLS 330, POLS 340, POLS 410, POLS 413, SOCI 1301. Standard 4-year BA sequence only; the catalog also publishes an accelerated 4+1 (BA+MPA) sequence which is not included here.
